title: Synthetic admissions marksheet review example
text:
# Synthetic demonstration only

This invented example is not an official or institution-approved rule. It exists only to demonstrate policy ingestion and retrieval plumbing.

## Candidate identity fields
A sample marksheet may be checked for a labelled candidate name and examination year. Missing or unreadable values should be sent for human review.

## Decision boundary
A field mismatch is an internal consistency signal only. It does not establish document authenticity or determine eligibility.
